title: docx2pdf-cli --doctor output
description: Structured host-readiness report emitted by `docx2pdf --doctor --json` (and the default form when stdout is not a TTY). Agents should validate against this schema rather than parsing prose.

platformKey.description: Refined platform identifier used to pick per-backend install commands (e.g. linux-apt, linux-dnf, darwin).

tools.description: Booleans for each tool we probe. Top-level for backward compat; also reflected in backends[name].available reasoning.

availableBackends.description: Backend names that are usable on this host right now. Empty array means no conversion will succeed without setup.

backends.description: Per-backend report keyed by backend name.

available.description: True if this backend can run on this host right now.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why the backend is or isn't available. Useful for surfacing to a user.

install.description: Platform-specific install command for this backend. Null when the backend is OS-locked (e.g. pages on Linux).

recommendation.description: Single best next step for this host. Null when at least one backend is already available.

backend.description: The backend name the recommendation refers to.

rationale.description: One-sentence explanation of why this is the best next step.

command.description: The exact shell command to run. May include sudo, brew, or docker run — agents should ask for consent before executing.
